findings.title: Linux prctl() Interface Usage
findings.description: Detected Linux '#include <sys/prctl.h>'.
findings.remediation: For thread naming, use pthread_setname_np(pthread_self(), "name"). For process control, use QNX ThreadCtl().
findings.rationale: Thread naming on QNX is performed via pthread_setname_np(). Process attributes and security capabilities are configured via ThreadCtl() or procmgr_* APIs.

findings.title: Non-Portable Linux epoll API Usage
findings.description: Detected '#include <sys/epoll.h>' which is unsupported on QNX SDP 8.0.
findings.remediation: Replace epoll with standard POSIX poll() or select() for socket loops. For high-performance native events, use QNX ionotify() with a sigevent pulse, allowing the event loop to block on MsgReceive().
findings.rationale: QNX Neutrino is a microkernel operating system that multiplexes events using ionotify(), standard POSIX poll()/select(), or native Neutrino Pulses/Channels.

findings.title: Non-Portable Linux timerfd API Usage
findings.description: Detected Linux '#include <sys/timerfd.h>'. Use POSIX timer_create() with SIGEV_PULSE.
findings.remediation: Use standard POSIX timer_create() with SIGEV_PULSE delivered to a QNX channel. If a file descriptor is strictly required by third-party abstractions, couple a POSIX timer to a pipe() or socketpair().
findings.rationale: QNX Neutrino timing architecture delivers real-time notifications via standard POSIX timers (timer_create) coupled to QNX Pulses (SIGEV_PULSE) directly into an IPC Channel.

findings.title: Non-Portable Linux eventfd API Usage
findings.description: Detected Linux 'eventfd'. Use POSIX pipe() or QNX Pulses.
findings.code_snippet: * Uses Linux eventfd and System V shared memory (Non-portable to QNX 8.0).
findings.remediation: Replace eventfd with a standard POSIX pipe() or socketpair() if an event fd is needed. For native QNX services, send a Neutrino Pulse via MsgSendPulse().
findings.rationale: QNX Neutrino provides lightweight non-blocking 8-byte Pulses (MsgSendPulse) for inter-thread and inter-process event signaling, with zero kernel memory allocation overhead.

findings.title: Linux sysfs (/sys/...) Path Dependency
findings.description: Detected Linux sysfs path '"/sys/class/'.
findings.remediation: Access device drivers through their QNX resource manager nodes under /dev/ using standard open()/devctl() calls.
findings.rationale: Hardware devices on QNX are managed by user-space Resource Managers under /dev/ (e.g. /dev/io-net, /dev/spi, /dev/i2c, /dev/ser1).

findings.title: Deprecated Compiler Flag '-lang-c++' in QNX 8.0
findings.description: The '-lang-c++' flag was used in legacy QNX toolchains to force C++ compilation with qcc. In QNX SDP 8.0 with GCC 12.2 and modern Clang, this flag is deprecated and triggers warnings or errors.
findings.remediation: Remove '-lang-c++'. Set CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER to 'q++' in your QNX toolchain file.
findings.remediation_code:
# In qnx.toolchain.cmake:
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER ${QNX_HOST}/usr/bin/q++)
findings.rationale: Modern CMake and QNX 8.0 use 'q++' directly or standard language flags (-x c++).

findings.title: Non-Standard GNU get_current_dir_name() Call
findings.description: get_current_dir_name() is a GNU libc extension not present in QNX SDP 8.0.
findings.remediation: Replace 'get_current_dir_name()' with POSIX 'getcwd(buf, sizeof(buf))'.
findings.rationale: Standard POSIX getcwd(buf, size) is fully supported across all POSIX compliant operating systems.

findings.title: Linux /proc/self/exe Symlink Dependency
findings.description: Linux exposes the running binary path via the '/proc/self/exe' symlink. QNX procfs does not provide this symlink.
findings.remediation: Use QNX global '_cmdname' or pass argv[0] to realpath() instead of reading /proc/self/exe.
findings.rationale: On QNX, procnto provides process memory mappings via '/proc/<pid>/as'. The executable path is commonly obtained through argv[0], the global '_cmdname' variable, or by querying dtv_entry structures.

findings.title: Legacy System V IPC Usage (shmget / semget / msgget)
findings.description: Detected System V IPC call '#include <sys/ipc.h>'.
findings.remediation: Migrate from System V IPC to POSIX IPC (shm_open, sem_open) or QNX native Channels.
findings.rationale: QNX Neutrino RTOS is optimized for synchronous message passing (MsgSend/MsgReceive), asynchronous Pulses, and POSIX memory objects (shm_open, sem_open).

findings.title: Unsafe GNU strndupa() / strdupa() Macro
findings.description: Detected GNU extension 'strndupa'.
findings.code_snippet: * Uses GNU pthread_yield, strndupa, and Linux sysfs /sys/class.
findings.remediation: Replace with POSIX strndup() and explicit free(), or use a bounded fixed-size stack buffer.
findings.rationale: QNX real-time threads typically operate with bounded stack sizes (e.g. 32KB to 256KB). Unbounded alloca() risks silent stack overflow.

findings.title: Non-Standard GNU pthread_yield() Call
findings.description: pthread_yield() is a deprecated GNU extension not defined in standard POSIX or QNX libc. Will cause 'implicit declaration of function' or linker error.
findings.remediation: Replace 'pthread_yield()' with standard POSIX 'sched_yield()' and include <sched.h>.
findings.remediation_code:
#include <sched.h>
sched_yield();
findings.rationale: POSIX specifies sched_yield() defined in <sched.h>.

findings.title: Redundant Host Library Linking (-lpthread, -ldl, -lrt)
findings.description: Found explicit 'pthread / -lpthread'. Threads and dlopen are built into QNX libc.so.
findings.remediation: Wrap 'pthread / -lpthread' in platform checks or remove it when CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL 'QNX'.
findings.rationale: Explicitly specifying -lpthread or -ldl is unnecessary on QNX and can lead to linker warnings or missing library errors if stub libraries are absent.

recommendations: Refactor epoll loops to standard POSIX poll() or leverage QNX ionotify() with pulses for event notification.
Convert Linux timerfd usage to POSIX timer_create() coupled with QNX SIGEV_PULSE delivered to a Neutrino channel.
Replace eventfd inter-thread signaling with POSIX pipes or lightweight non-blocking QNX Pulses.
Replace non-standard pthread_yield() calls with standard POSIX sched_yield() from <sched.h>.
Replace /proc/self/exe resolution with the QNX _cmdname global pointer or argv[0] path resolution.
Replace Linux prctl() calls with standard pthread_setname_np() for thread names and QNX ThreadCtl() for process controls.
Remove deprecated '-lang-c++' flags from build files; configure CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER to point to 'q++'.
Remove explicit '-lpthread', '-ldl', and '-lrt' from linker flags; these are integrated into QNX libc.so.
